title: Senior Software Engineer at Phaidra
description_review: Senior Software Engineer role at Phaidra developing AI-powered control systems and reinforcement learning agents for industrial automation. Focuses on transforming static, monolithic facilities into adaptive systems through domain-expert configurable agents. Fully remote role based in the United States.
pros: Strong focus on AI agents and replacing legacy/monolithic control systems
Senior software engineering scope working on high-impact production AI systems
Modernization of legacy industrial infrastructure aligns with candidate's modernization background
cons: Specialized reinforcement learning/industrial controls stack rather than Java/Spring enterprise stack
Role is US-based remote, potentially requiring US work authorization

title: ML Engineer at Trunk Tools, Inc.
description_review: ML Engineer role at Trunk Tools, a Series B funded startup building intelligent automation and multi-agent systems for the construction industry. Responsibilities include owning core search, retrieval, and multi-agent orchestration platforms for production-ready AI agents. Offers $183,000 USD salary.
pros: Directly matches candidate's experience building multi-agent platforms and agent orchestration harnesses
High-growth Series B AI company deploying production-ready multi-agent workflows
Clear salary transparency ($183,000 USD) and platform ownership
cons: Focus is Machine Learning / ML engineering rather than traditional enterprise Java backend
May require specialized Python/ML framework depth

title: Senior Backend Developer (Node.js / Nest.js) at Proxify
description_review: Senior Backend Developer position at Proxify working with Node.js and Nest.js for building scalable web applications and APIs. Requires 5+ years of Node.js, 3+ years Nest.js, REST/GraphQL APIs, TypeScript, and relational/NoSQL databases. Remote position for candidates in CET timezone (+/- 3 hours).
pros: Senior backend scope focusing on scalable web architectures and REST APIs
Aligns with candidate's TypeScript and SQL/NoSQL database proficiency
Full-time remote position tailored for CET (+/- 3 hours) timezone
cons: Demands 5+ years Node.js and 3+ years Nest.js as primary requirement instead of Java/Spring Boot
Lacks banking/fintech domain context and applied GenAI components

title: Senior Cloud Engineer (Azure) at Proxify
description_review: Senior Cloud Engineer role at Proxify specializing in Microsoft Azure to design, automate, and maintain cloud infrastructure. Requires 5+ years managing enterprise Azure environments, VNets, container orchestration, CI/CD automation, and zero-trust security. Full-time remote within CET (+/- 3 hours).
pros: Enterprise infrastructure and container orchestration focus
Remote role compatible with CET timezone
cons: Pure Cloud Engineer / DevOps role rather than software development
Weak fit per profile guidelines (explicitly advises against pure DevOps/cloud roles)
No Java, Spring Boot, or application programming scope

title: Senior Data Engineer (Azure) at Proxify
description_review: Senior Data Engineer position at Proxify focused on Microsoft Azure data solutions and pipeline orchestration. Requires 5+ years of data engineering, advanced SQL performance tuning, Azure Data Factory/SQL, ETL pipelines, and data warehouse architectures. Fully remote for CET (+/- 3 hours) time zone.
pros: Senior scope dealing with enterprise data architecture, complex SQL, and pipeline orchestration
cons: Dedicated Data Engineering/ETL role rather than software engineering/microservices development
No Java/Spring Boot backend engineering or application development focus
Lack of banking/fintech domain context or applied AI agent work
